recognize_zh: 兩個視野中可見明顯大於周圍細胞的大型異型細胞，細胞質深藍、帶空泡與顆粒，核圓或不規則、部分呈雙葉或馬蹄形，成群出現於抹片中，符合間變性大細胞淋巴瘤（ALCL）侵犯骨髓；需以 CD30、ALK 確認。
features: Large atypical cells, several times the size of red cells, occurring singly and in small clusters
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with vacuoles and scattered coarse granules
Round to irregular nuclei, including a bilobed/horseshoe-like form, with moderately fine chromatin
Some cells show a perinuclear clear zone and cytoplasmic blebbing
Background of red cells with anisocytosis and occasional small lymphocytes; normal hematopoietic precursors are sparse in these fields
describe_en: Smear (Wright-Giemsa) from the bone marrow shows scattered and loosely clustered large atypical cells in a red-cell-rich background. The cells have abundant, deeply basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm with coarse granules and round to irregular nuclei, including bilobed or horseshoe-shaped forms. Normal trilineage hematopoietic precursors are not well represented in these fields, which may reflect a hemodilute aspirate. Findings are consistent with involvement by a large cell lymphoma, and in the given context are compatible with anaplastic large cell lymphoma; confirmation by flow cytometry and CD30/ALK immunohistochemistry on the biopsy is required.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts have folded delicate nuclei, grey-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and are MPO/NSE/CD14-positive rather than CD30/ALK-positive.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor or carcinoma
ddx.vs: Metastatic tumor cells form cohesive clumps with moulding and are keratin or neuroendocrine marker positive.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized and uniform with sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles and are CD20/CD10-positive with MYC rearrangement.
Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei with a paranuclear hof and are CD138/MUM1-positive rather than ALK/CD30-driven T-cell phenotype.
